question: Hey, Odacchi! On page 109 of Volume 71, was Luffy going to call Bellamy "Mallony"?! Was he thinking of the snack food company Malony? If Luffy's head is full of nothing but food, then I'm more like Sanji—my head is full of girls. What's inside your head, Odacchi?
answer: I don't think about girls the way you do. It's nothing but serious bustiness--ahem, business--in there. And you're right about Luffy's train of thought! I guess he only remembered the rhythm of the name.
name: Shin
